scenes.name: title
scenes.narration: Vigil: a post-quantum rollup with a watchtower, on the QoreChain testnet. Here is the demo.

scenes.name: home
scenes.caption: Vigil: a rollup that checks itself
scenes.narration: Vigil is a post-quantum rollup on QoreChain with its own watchtower. Every batch is re-executed the moment it lands, and a wrong one is challenged before it can settle. On the right, the watchtower's live view of the latest batches.

scenes.name: overview
scenes.caption: The dashboard, live
scenes.narration: The dashboard shows the rollup right now: inbox entries, batches, re-executed batches, final batches and on-chain receipts.

scenes.name: signin
scenes.caption: Sign in to the operator wallet
scenes.narration: The wallet signs server side, behind a password. The password is typed from the environment and never shown.

scenes.name: transfer
scenes.caption: A rollup transfer, signed with ML-DSA-44
scenes.narration: Now a transfer to another rollup account. It is signed with M L D S A 44 and posted to the rollup's inbox on QoreChain.

scenes.name: withdraw
scenes.caption: Withdraw back to the base chain
scenes.narration: A withdrawal goes through the same inbox. It can be claimed with a Merkle proof once its batch is final.

scenes.name: batched
scenes.caption: Batched, and re-executed by the watchtower
scenes.narration: Seconds later the batcher submits a batch with an M L D S A 87 anchor. The watchtower re-executes it independently and marks it valid. The chain gives it one hour before it is final.

scenes.name: receipt
scenes.caption: Settlement recorded on chain
scenes.narration: Once final, the batch's post-quantum anchor is verified by the Vigil Receipts contract, which reads the signer's key from QoreChain's registry, and records it permanently.

scenes.name: memo
scenes.caption: Private memos, sealed with ML-KEM-1024
scenes.narration: Payments can carry a private memo, encrypted with M L KEM 1024 to the recipient's registered key, and bound to a signed transfer.

scenes.name: proof
scenes.caption: A forged batch, stopped in 5 seconds
scenes.narration: This really happened on the testnet. An attacker bonded a thousand Q O R and posted a forged batch. Two seconds later the watchtower found the wrong state root. Three seconds after that, its fraud proof was confirmed. The chain threw the batch out, and the attacker's bond was slashed.

scenes.name: chain
scenes.caption: Watching QoreChain itself
scenes.narration: Vigil also watches QoreChain itself: block production, block time against the documented value, and silent changes to its settings.

scenes.name: learn
scenes.caption: Learn, Docs and Proof, built in
scenes.narration: Learn, Docs and Proof are built in: the concept, the threat model, and every claim with its transactions.

scenes.name: end
scenes.narration: Vigil. Post-quantum settlement, always watched. Open source under Apache 2.
